name: MacOS menu bar time visualizer with screen blur

mentions.name: MacOS menu bar time visualizer with screen blur
mentions.description: This macOS menu bar app visualizes time passing by showing a thin, always-visible line at the bottom of the screen that shrinks inward as time elapses; when the allotted time ends, the screen blurs to interrupt hyperfocus. The timer duration and blur length are configurable, and a loop feature enables pomodoro-style cycles with enforced breaks.
mentions.problem: Time blindness during hyperfocus on work, programming, reading, or research leads to forgotten meals, missed breaks and meetings, and lost hours, and typical notifications fail to snap the user out of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: The app creates a thin, always visible line at the bottom of my screen that shrinks inwards as time passes, at the end of the allotted time the screen will blur preventing me from doing whatever I was doing and snapping me out of my hyperfocus state. I can choose how long the timer runs for and how long the screen blurs for. Tonight I added a loop feature so I can use it like a pomodoro timer with enforced breaks.
